rule.explanationUz:
Ingliz tilida ko'plik OT OXIRIGA qo'shimcha qo'shib yasaladi.
O'zbekchada '-lar', inglizchada '-s' yoki '-es'.

Qaysi biri qo'shilishi otning OXIRGI HARFIGA bog'liq.

rules.enRule: Most nouns take -s in the plural.
Nouns ending in -ss, -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -o take -es in the plural.

rule.noteUz:
NEGA -es? Chunki 's' tovushidan keyin yana 's' aytib bo'lmaydi.
  bus + s = 'bass' — eshitilmaydi
  bus + es = 'BAS-iz' — eshitiladi
Ya'ni -es qo'shimchasi TALAFFUZ uchun kerak. Uni /iz/ deb o'qiladi.
rule.extraUz:
TALAFFUZ 3 xil bo'ladi:
  /s/  — jarangsiz tovushdan keyin: books, cats, desks
  /z/  — jarangli tovushdan keyin: rooms, walls, chairs
  /iz/ — s, ss, sh, ch, x, ge dan keyin: buses, brushes, benches

Bu farqni yozuvda ko'rsatmaydi, lekin gapirishda muhim.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the following, then complete the rules.
exercises.explanationUz:
Kitobdagi qoida:

  Nouns ending in ................ take -es in the plural.

Jadvalga qarang: address, bus, brush, bench — ularning
oxirgi harflari qanday? Ana o'sha javob.

items.textEn: Nouns ending in ______ take -es in the plural.
items.uz: Qaysi harflar bilan tugagan otlar -es oladi?
items.whyUz: Jadvaldan: address (-ss), bus (-s), brush (-sh), bench (-ch). Bularga -x (box) va -o (tomato) ham qo'shiladi.

exercises.explanationUz:
Jadvaldagi 8 ta so'z + Unit 3 lug'atidan yana bir nechtasi.
Har birida -s yoki -es tanlashingiz kerak.

rule.explanationUz:
To'rt so'z ikki narsani bir vaqtda ko'rsatadi:
  1) YAQINMI yoki UZOQMI?
  2) BITTAMI yoki KO'PMI?

              BITTA (singular)   KO'P (plural)
  YAQIN (near)   this              these
  UZOQ  (far)    that              those

O'zbekchada: bu / bular, u / ular — deyarli bir xil tizim.

rules.enRule: We use this/these for things near us.
We use that/those for things far from us.

rule.warningUz:
ENG KO'P XATO — fe'lni unutish:
  ❌ This a chair.        ✅ This IS a chair.
  ❌ These is chairs.     ✅ These ARE chairs.

is/are ko'rsatish olmoshiga qarab tanlanadi:
  this / that  → IS
  these / those → ARE
rule.extraUz:
TALAFFUZ farqi:
  this  /ðɪs/  — qisqa 'i'
  these /ðiːz/ — cho'ziq 'ii' va oxirida 'z'
Ikkalasi juda o'xshash eshitiladi, shuning uchun ot ko'plikmi-yo'qmi
ekaniga qarab ham tushunish mumkin.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the following, then complete the rules.
exercises.explanationUz:
Kitobdagi qoida:

  We use ........./......... for things far from us.

items.textEn: We use ______ for things far from us.
items.uz: Uzoqdagi narsalar uchun qaysi juftlik ishlatiladi?
items.whyUz: FAR qatoridagi namunalar: 'That is a clock.' va 'Those are clocks.'

exercises.instructionEn: Write sentences, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir raqamda IKKITA rasm bor: birinchisi YAQIN (this/these),
ikkinchisi UZOQ (that/those).

Namuna: This is a sofa and that is a table.

Qadam-qadam:
  1) Birinchi narsa bittami? → This is a ...
     Ko'pmi?              → These are ...
  2) Ikkinchi narsa bittami? → that is a ...
     Ko'pmi?               → those are ...

DIQQAT: gap o'rtasidagi 'that/those' KICHIK harf bilan yoziladi.
Va 'and' dan oldin vergul qo'yilmaydi.

example.en: This is a sofa and that is a table.

modelSentences.sentence: This is a desk and those are chairs.
modelSentences.uz: Bu yozuv stoli, ular esa stullar.

modelSentences.sentence: This is a bench and those are lamps.
This is a mirror and those are towels.
This is a bookcase and that is a fireplace.
modelSentences.uz: Bu kitob javoni, u esa kamin.

modelSentences.sentence: This is a cooker and that is a fridge.

rule.explanationUz:
Bu tuzilma 'BIROR JOYDA NIMADIR BOR' deyish uchun ishlatiladi.
'There' bu yerda 'u yerda' degani EMAS — u shunchaki gapni boshlash uchun
turadigan so'z. Tarjima qilinmaydi.

  There is a bed in the bedroom.  — Yotoqxonada karavot bor.
  (so'zma-so'z: 'bor bitta karavot yotoqxonada')

examples.q: Is there a bed in the bedroom?
Are there any chairs in the kitchen?

keyRules.enRule: We use there is in the singular.
examples: There is a bed in the bedroom.

keyRules.enRule: We use there are in the plural.
examples: There are two beds in the bedroom.

keyRules.enRule: We use some in the plural in the affirmative.
examples: There are some chairs in the kitchen.

keyRules.uzRule: Ko'plik + INKOR va SAVOL gapda — ANY.
keyRules.enRule: We use any in the plural in the negative and interrogative.
examples: There aren't any chairs in the kitchen.
Are there any chairs in the kitchen?

rule.warningUz:
SOME yoki ANY?
  ✅ There are SOME chairs.        (tasdiq)
  ✅ There aren't ANY chairs.      (inkor)
  ✅ Are there ANY chairs?         (savol)
  ❌ There aren't some chairs.
  ❌ Are there some chairs?

Oson eslash: 'some' — faqat TASDIQDA. Qolgan ikkisida 'any'.
rule.noteUz:
Qisqartmalar:
  there is not  = there isn't
  there are not = there aren't
Og'zaki nutqda deyarli doim qisqa shakl ishlatiladi.

Savolda so'z tartibi ALMASHADI:
  There is a bed. → IS THERE a bed?
  There are beds. → ARE THERE any beds?

exercises.explanationUz: Kitobdagi to'ldirilishi kerak bo'lgan uchta qoida.

items.textEn: We use there ______ in the plural. (There ___ two beds in the bedroom.)

items.textEn: We use ______ in the plural in the negative and interrogative.
items.uz: Ko'plik inkor va savol gaplarda qaysi so'z ishlatiladi?
items.whyUz: There aren't ANY chairs. / Are there ANY chairs? — 'some' faqat tasdiq gapda.

exercises.instructionEn: What things can you see in the picture below? Put a tick (✓) or a cross (✗) for each.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi rasmda qaysi narsalarni ko'rasiz? Har biri uchun ✓ yoki ✗ qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
Rasmda ovqatlanish xonasi tasvirlangan.
Kitob betini ochib rasmga qarang, so'ng har bir buyum bormi-yo'qmi belgilang.

Berilgan namunalar: dining-table ✓, armchair ✗, pictures ✓, posters ✗

items.whyUz: Namuna: rasm o'rtasida katta yumaloq ovqat stoli turibdi.
Namuna: xonada faqat oddiy stullar bor, kreslo yo'q.
Namuna: rasmlar bor, lekin plakat yo'q.
Bu ovqatlanish xonasi, divan mehmonxonada bo'ladi.
Stol atrofida bir nechta yog'och stul turibdi.
Shkaf ko'rinmaydi — u odatda oshxonada bo'ladi.
Devorda faqat rasmlar bor, oyna yo'q.
O'ng tomondagi derazada oq pardalar osilgan.
Karavot yotoqxonada bo'ladi, ovqatlanish xonasida emas.
Yostiq karavotda bo'ladi, bu yerda yo'q.

exercises.instructionEn: Talk about the room, as in the examples.
exercises.explanationUz:
Ikkita buyumni BITTA gapda qarama-qarshi qo'yamiz:
  bor buyum + BUT + yo'q buyum

Namunalar:
  There is a dining-table but there isn't an armchair.
  There are some pictures but there aren't any posters.

DIQQAT — 4 ta shakl bir gapda:
  bor,  bitta  → There is a/an ...
  yo'q, bitta  → there isn't a/an ...
  bor,  ko'p   → There are some ...
  yo'q, ko'p   → there aren't any ...

Va 'an armchair' — 'a' emas, chunki 'armchair' unli tovush bilan boshlanadi.

example.en: There is a dining-table but there isn't an armchair.
example.uz: Ovqat stoli bor, lekin kreslo yo'q.

example.en: There are some pictures but there aren't any posters.

There are some chairs but there aren't any cupboards.

There are some flowers but there aren't any pillows.

groups.explanationUz: Bu tovushlardan keyin -s eshitilmaydi, shuning uchun -es qo'shiladi va /iz/ deb o'qiladi.
Bu so'zlar ham birlik/ko'plikka qarab o'zgaradi — ot kabi -s olmaydi, butunlay boshqa so'zga aylanadi.
not so'zi fe'lga qo'shilib qisqaradi. Apostrof (') tushib qolgan 'o' o'rnida turadi.

patterns.formula: This is a ... and that is a ...
patterns.exampleEn: This is a sofa and that is a table.
patterns.explanationUz:
Ikkala narsa ham BITTA. Yaqindagi — this, uzoqdagi — that.
Gap o'rtasida 'that' kichik harf bilan yoziladi.

patterns.formula: This is a ... and those are ...
patterns.exampleEn: This is a desk and those are chairs.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu yozuv stoli, ular esa stullar.
patterns.explanationUz:
Birinchisi bitta (this is a), ikkinchisi ko'p (those are + ko'plik ot).
DIQQAT: ko'plikda 'a' QO'YILMAYDI — those are chairs (a chairs emas).

patterns.formula: There is a/an ... in the XONA.
patterns.exampleEn: There is a bed in the bedroom.

patterns.formula: There are some ... in the XONA.
patterns.exampleEn: There are some chairs in the kitchen.

patterns.formula: There isn't a/an ... / There aren't any ...
patterns.exampleEn: There isn't an armchair. There aren't any posters.

patterns.formula: Is there a/an ...? — Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.
patterns.exampleEn: Is there a bed in the bedroom? — Yes, there is.
patterns.explanationUz: Savolda 'Is' oldinga chiqadi. Qisqa javobda 'a bed' TAKRORLANMAYDI.

patterns.formula: Are there any ...? — Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.
patterns.exampleEn: Are there any chairs in the kitchen? — No, there aren't.

patterns.formula: There is a ... BUT there isn't a ...
patterns.exampleEn: There is a dining-table but there isn't an armchair.
patterns.exampleUz: Ovqat stoli bor, lekin kreslo yo'q.
patterns.explanationUz: 'but' — 'lekin'. Ikki qarama-qarshi fikrni bitta gapga birlashtiradi.
